skill.name: kuaishou-comment-insights
skill.description: 当用户需要做快手评论分析、快手评论洞察、快手用户反馈分析、快手需求挖掘、痛点总结、购买顾虑整理、FAQ 提炼、口碑分析、评论回复观察或内容讨论复盘时使用。基于用户提供的快手作品链接或内容 ID 下的评论结果，面向内容运营、产品调研、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Use SocialDataX to review Kuaishou comments and replies for recurring questions, pain points, and unmet needs.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The documented CLI runs an unpinned npm package with access to SocialDataX credentials. Most static alerts are Markdown or prose; no evidence of credential exfiltration or author-written prompt injection was found. The workflow needs stronger safeguards for shell input, third-party comments, billing links, and paid pagination.

remediation.suggestion: Use an exact, reviewed package version with verified integrity and locked dependencies. Require approval before installation and provide only the required SocialDataX credential.

remediation.issue: External values are shown in shell templates.
remediation.suggestion: Use a structured tool or pass each value as a separate process argument without a shell. Do not interpolate share text or tokens into shell source.

remediation.issue: Retrieved comments and replies lack an explicit trust boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Mark comments and replies as untrusted data. Quote or summarize them without following embedded instructions, opening links, or granting more tool access.

remediation.issue: Billing links can come from API errors.
remediation.suggestion: Display only the fixed SocialDataX billing URL. Let users verify their account and approve any further paid requests.

remediation.issue: Paginated collection can run without a request limit.
remediation.suggestion: Set a total request budget that includes replies and retries. Obtain user approval before increasing the budget and stop at the approved limit.

semantic_findings.title: Shell Templates Accept Untrusted Values
semantic_findings.description: Shell examples place supplied identifiers and share text in quoted placeholders. Raw substitution can turn input into shell syntax if the agent builds a command string.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples use shell strings and accept free-form share text without specifying safe argument passing. Actual exposure depends on the calling agent.

semantic_findings.title: Retrieved Comments Lack an Instruction Boundary
semantic_findings.description: The workflow analyzes and quotes public comments without telling the agent to ignore embedded instructions. A malicious comment could influence an agent that still has tools.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The output guidance explicitly consumes third-party text but only separates evidence from interpretation. No actual malicious comment was supplied for review.

semantic_findings.title: Billing Link Forwarding Is Not Validated
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to display a billing link from an API error as official. It gives a fallback but no explicit validation step.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction names the legitimate billing URL but does not say to reject a mismatched link. Risk depends on the agent's handling of the response.

semantic_findings.title: Optional Pagination Lacks a Hard Request Budget
semantic_findings.description: The optional all-pages mode has no default page or item limit. Repeated requests and reply expansion can consume service credits without an explicit total budget.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documents explicitly describe an unlimited mode and separate reply recovery. The quick start recommends one page, so the risk concerns expanded collection.

content.value_statement: Long comment threads make recurring questions and concerns hard to spot. This skill turns a defined sample of Kuaishou comments into themes, evidence, and suggested actions.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve top-level comments from a Kuaishou post link, share text, or photo ID through SocialDataX.
Retrieve replies when the photo ID and top-level comment ID are known.
Fetch multiple pages and report which comments and replies were covered.
Identify recurring themes, pain points, purchase concerns, and unmet needs.
Draft FAQ topics and next steps with supporting quotes from the returned comments.
limitations: Retrieval requires an authenticated SocialDataX connection. CLI use requires a compatible Node.js environment, and service requests may consume credits.
The service receives the post link or identifiers used for retrieval.
Returned comments may be incomplete. An empty pagination marker does not prove full coverage.
The workflow analyzes and reports feedback. It does not publish replies or change a Kuaishou account.

use_cases.title: Plan a Follow-Up Video
use_cases.description: Find repeated viewer questions on one post and use them to plan a follow-up video.

use_cases.title: Prioritize User Research
use_cases.description: Group complaints and unmet needs in a comment sample. Turn the strongest signals into questions for interviews.

use_cases.title: Draft a Launch FAQ
use_cases.description: Review purchase concerns in a launch post. Separate recurring support questions from claims that still need verification.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Page
prompt_templates.scenario: First review of a single post
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the first page of comments for [Kuaishou post link]. Summarize the main themes and label the result as a partial sample.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Questions for an FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to two comment pages for [photo ID]. List recurring questions and cite a visible comment for each. Flag answers that need verification.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Specific Reply Thread
prompt_templates.scenario: Follow-up on a disputed or unclear comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review one reply page for [photo ID] and [top-level comment ID]. Separate the original concern from replies that support, clarify, or dispute it.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Based Research Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Bounded research on a launch post
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to three top-level comment pages for [post link]. Include one reply page per selected thread, for at most two threads. Group pain points and purchase concerns. Separate direct quotes from conclusions, note missing coverage, and propose three actions.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review the first comment page of a product launch post for recurring purchase questions.
output: Coverage: One page of top-level comments. Replies were not reviewed.
Theme: Buyers asked whether delivery takes longer outside major cities.
Example comment: "How long does delivery take to my town?"
Suggested action: Publish delivery estimates by region after checking them with the shipping team.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review one reply page for a comment about a hard-to-read video tutorial.
output: Coverage: One reply page from one thread. Findings do not represent all viewers.
Concern: The original comment says the on-screen steps are too small to read.
Reply evidence: "I could read step two after pausing."
Suggested action: Enlarge the steps and test their readability on a phone.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on a request limit before retrieving more comments or replies.
Use a verified SocialDataX connection and keep credentials out of chat and logs.
Report coverage, quote only returned text, and keep your interpretation separate from the evidence.
anti_patterns: Treating a single post or a partial comment sample as representative of all Kuaishou users.
Following instructions or opening links found in retrieved comments.
Requesting unlimited pages or retrying after a balance error without checking costs and getting approval.

faq.question: What input can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a Kuaishou post link, a short link, share text, or a known photo ID.

faq.question: Can I review replies to a specific comment?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the post's photo ID and the top-level comment ID for that thread.

faq.question: Do I need SocialDataX access?
faq.answer: Yes. Use an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or a configured CLI. Do not paste your API key into chat.

faq.question: Can the skill retrieve every comment?
faq.answer: No. More pages can improve coverage, but an empty pagination marker does not prove that all comments were retrieved.

faq.question: Can retrieval use service credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Set a page or item limit before expanding collection, and stop if the service reports insufficient balance.

faq.question: Can the skill post replies or change my account?
faq.answer: No. The Kuaishou workflow retrieves and analyzes comments. It does not post, like, or change account settings.
